generate_model_card: run the generate_model_card script to automatically create a model card markdown file for a ParlAI model
setup_args: build a ParlaiParser with model card generation arguments including model type, folder to save, and evaluation tasks
save_data_stats: run the save_data_stats method to collect and save dataset statistics for training and evaluation tasks
save_eval: run the save_eval method to evaluate a model on test datasets and save results to a JSON file
create_model_card: build a model card dictionary with sections including model details, datasets used, evaluation results, and hyperparameters
